title: Lettre Tate (mai 66) (Cristaux) : lettre (1966), tapuscrit (s.d.), notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: these are notes accompanying the 1966 letter to Tate on Dieudonné crystals of (truncated) Barsotti–Tate groups. On S (with p nilpotent, essentially char p), a p-group G has a contravariant Dieudonné crystal D*(G) = M with Frobenius F: M^(p) -> M and Verschiebung V: M -> M^(p). Grothendieck works with a 'duality triangle' relating three objects: the co-Lie complex ℓ^G_· of G, the dual of the co-Lie complex of the Cartier dual G* (shifted by 1), and Δ_·(G), the value of the crystal on S (previous page: Δ*(G) ≅ ε*(M/p)). This triangle is a derived form of the Hodge filtration 0 -> ω_G -> D(G)_S -> Lie(G*) -> 0.

The previous page treated étale G. There ℓ^G = 0, so the triangle collapses to ℓ̌^{G*}[1] ≅ Δ(G) ≅ RHom(G, O_S) ≅ Ğ ⊗^L O_S. It then began the multiplicative-type case. Such a G is determined by its étale dual G*, and D*(G) = G*_{S'} ⊗ O_{S'}. Here V is an isomorphism (induced from the Frobenius of G*), so F is determined by V. This gives an equivalence: truncated BT_n of multiplicative type ≅ locally free crystals on S/Λ_n with V an isomorphism.

This page:
(1) The same equivalence holds for multiplicative-type groups killed by a power of p. For multiplicative G one has ℓ̌^{G*}[1] = 0, since G* is étale. The triangle therefore reduces to an isomorphism ℓ^G_· ≅ Δ_·(G), with ℓ^G ≅ G* ⊗^L_Z O_S ≅ (G* ⊗^L_Z F_p) ⊗_{F_p} O_S. Sanity check: for G = μ_{p^n}, G* = Z/p^n, and ℓ^G = [O_S --p^n--> O_S], as it should be.
(2) New section: homomorphisms between étale p-groups and groups of multiplicative type.
(a) Every homomorphism from a multiplicative-type G to an étale G' is zero. On the crystal side, every homomorphism u: M' -> M of F-V-crystals (or even of F-crystals alone, or V-crystals alone) is zero, where M' = D*(G') and M = D*(G). Proof: from u∘F_{M'} = F_M∘u^(p) one gets u∘F^n_{M'} = F^n_M∘u^(p^n). Here F^n_{M'} is an isomorphism (étale case) and F^n_M = 0 for n large (multiplicative case, F nilpotent on a crystal killed by p^n). Hence u = 0. The V-case is symmetric: V_M is invertible and V_{M'} is nilpotent.
(b) Homomorphisms from étale to multiplicative are announced but left blank. The next page instead develops the equivalence between étale F_p-sheaves E and crystals with invertible Frobenius ('unit-root'), via E ↦ (E ⊗ O_S, F_E ⊗ 1). Full faithfulness there rests on Γ(S,E) ≅ {x : F(x^(p)) = x}. These are steps toward showing the crystal functor is fully faithful on the étale and multiplicative parts and on morphisms between them.
errors: Hom(multiplicative, étale) = 0 needs p nilpotent on S, or char p. In characteristic 0, μ_n ≅ Z/n is both. The context assumes this but the page does not restate it.

'F_M^n est nul' is right for crystals over S/Λ_n (killed by p^n). For non-truncated BT groups over Z_p-crystals, F^n_M is only p^n·(unit), not zero. One then needs p-adic separatedness and torsion-freeness to conclude u = 0. Minor.
Section b) is left empty; the argument is not carried out on this page.

ideas.what: Derived duality triangle ℓ^G -> Δ(G) -> ℓ̌^{G*}[1] (derived Hodge filtration of the Dieudonné crystal of a truncated BT group), specialized to the multiplicative case: ℓ^G ≅ Δ(G) ≅ G* ⊗^L O_S.
ideas.modern_name: Hodge filtration of the Dieudonné crystal / co-Lie complex of a truncated BT group
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Montreal 1970 lectures), Mazur–Messing, Illusie (co-Lie complex, Astérisque 127, 1985)
ideas.where_published: Grothendieck, 'Groupes de Barsotti-Tate et cristaux de Dieudonné' (Montreal 1970/1974) discusses ℓ^G and the Hodge filtration; whether this exact triangle appears there is unsure

ideas.what: Multiplicative-type truncated BT groups ≅ crystals with V invertible; D*(G) = G* ⊗ O.
ideas.modern_name: Dieudonné theory of multiplicative-type groups (V-unit / slope-0 for V)
ideas.where_published: Possibly in the Montreal lectures; developed in BBM, Théorie de Dieudonné cristalline II

ideas.what: Hom(multiplicative, étale) = 0, mirrored on crystals by nilpotent-vs-invertible Frobenius (Frobenius slope argument).
ideas.modern_name: Orthogonality of slope parts / no maps from nilpotent-F to unit-F crystals

ideas.what: Planned treatment of Hom(étale, multiplicative), leading (next page) to étale F_p-sheaves ≅ unit-root F-crystals.
ideas.modern_name: Katz's equivalence between unit-root F-crystals and étale Z_p-local systems
ideas.usually_credited_to: N. Katz (p-adic properties of modular schemes, 1973); also Crew

missed.claim: Grothendieck had an explicit form of the unit-root F-crystal / étale sheaf equivalence in these (post-1966, likely c.1970) notes. This is a precursor to what is usually credited to Katz (1973). It is, however, on the next page rather than this one, and the idea was in the air (SGA 7/Dwork context).
missed.quote: b) Hom. d'un groupe étale G dans un groupe de t.m. G'.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Minor priority/history point about the unit-root crystal equivalence. Mathematically standard today.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine bookkeeping in Dieudonné crystal theory. It covers the collapse of the duality triangle for multiplicative groups and a standard Frobenius-nilpotence argument that Hom(mult, étale) = 0. The derived co-Lie triangle is a nice period detail but is known in spirit from the Montreal lectures and Illusie.
transcription_corrections: 'en notant que F_M^n est nul [?] et F_{M'}^n est nul' should read roughly 'en notant que F_{M'}^n est un isom. et F_M^n est nul (pour n grand)'. The étale crystal M' has invertible F; the multiplicative M has nilpotent F.
'd'où généralité [?] le résultat' is probably 'd'où justifié le résultat' or 'd'où découle le résultat'.
'tout hom. ~ de F-V-cristaux' is 'tout hom. (de F-V-cristaux, ou simplement de F-cristaux, ou de V-cristaux)': an inserted parenthesis.
Line 3: 'Ici ℓ̌^{G*}_·[1] = 0'; the struck-out phrase reads like 'On conclut encore'.
Section title: 'Homomorphismes entre p-groupes étales et groupes de t.m.' with 'formels' struck out.
